sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful: it preserves exact controlled iceClass cardinality, correctly separates applicable IA/IA Super ships dated before 2003-09-01 from non-applicable classes, includes all required constants, operands, units, result, and uses the correctly directed bounded formula comparison with tolerance scaled from the expected clamped result. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability branching: SHACL-SPARQL SELECT rows are violations, so the second alternative currently rejects applicable IA ships whose date is before 2003-09-01, while allowing IA Super ships after the cutoff and all non-IA/IA Super classes to bypass every substantive coefficient, operand, and formula constraint. The first alternative also requires only iceClassIaSuper despite its IA-or-IA-Super message. Encode a conforming non-applicable alternative for the other controlled classes and a single applicable alternative requiring iceClass IA or IA Super plus constructionStageDate before 2003-09-01; place all Table 3-3 constants, operands, units, result, and bounded formula comparison in that applicable alternative. Preserve the existing exact controlled iceClass cardinality and correctly computed clamped formula.

Preserve the exact global iceClass cardinality and controlled-value constraint, but replace the current three-way sh:or branching. The first alternative incorrectly allows any IA Super ship to pass all substantive checks without constructionStageDate and omits IA ships; the second alternative contains only the date check and therefore allows applicable IA/IA Super ships to bypass the coefficients, operands, result, and formula. Use one applicable alternative requiring iceClass exactly IA or IA Super, constructionStageDate xsd:date before 2003-09-01, all Table 3-3 constants with their declared units, shipLength, iceClassDraught, shipBreadth, clampedHullGeometryTerm, and the bounded formula comparison. Use one non-applicable alternative for exactly IB, IC, II, or III with no substantive requirements. Keep the derived-result tolerance scaled from the expected clamped formula result.

The candidate is semantically faithful: it preserves exact controlled iceClass cardinality, correctly separates applicable IA/IA Super ships dated before 2003-09-01 from non-applicable classes, includes all required constants, operands, units, result, and uses the correctly directed bounded formula comparison with tolerance scaled from the expected clamped result. Deterministic validation is valid.
